facts.fact: 六月中旬（mid-June）闷热，我一如既往早起，但丈夫总比我起得更早
facts.quote: The mid-June heat radiated from my skin, the sheets sticking as I peeled them off.

facts.fact: 丈夫 Dorian 在晨间读报等我，祝我即将到来的专利申请（patent appointment）顺利——我是发明家
facts.quote: I would say I wanted you to save all your energy for the upcoming patent appointment

facts.fact: Dorian 把 wedding day 那天为我买的浅蓝丝绸围巾打成蝴蝶结系上我的脖子；当时两人没什么钱，那是他勉强买得起的礼物
facts.quote: the light blue silk he’d bought for me on our wedding day

facts.fact: Dorian 此行共三天，带着银质钢笔和幸运银表去赶火车；他临走唤我 Lucia，并提醒我父亲想见我
Dorian 要面试天文工程职位；其实职位早就是他的——昨晚我的手伸进 Otherside（仪式）那一刻就已注定
facts.quote: that position had been his the minute my hand dipped through to the Otherside last night.

facts.fact: 城市 Astraea 是美洲海岸最伟大的城市，名字源自意为“星”的 astēr，居民宗教文化上都崇拜星辰
facts.quote: Before Astraea was the greatest city on the coast of the Americas.

facts.fact: 本周 Lax Festival 轮到我家所在的 Aisl Park 举办，四个行政区每周末轮换一个月，其余为 Alton Heights、Dieton、Castor
facts.quote: This weekend it was being hosted in my home borough, Aisl Park.

facts.fact: 我把花园里编好的猫薄荷草绳贿赂店主 Samuele 换肥料，他喊话说下次要带 Dorian 一起来，好确认我没把可怜的 Dorian 拿去做实验
facts.quote: “Throw me out, Samuele—then she will miss my bribes!”
